description: HIVMeet backend lifecycle governance for Codex. Stop hook is intentionally disabled because Codex's Stop event does not expose the final assistant message reliably and the audit-marker check would block every subsequent prompt.

hooks.command: python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.agents/hooks/lifecycle_hook.py" --event prompt --scope backend --host codex --map "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.agents/project-map.json"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& (Join-Path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) '.agents/hooks/invoke-agent-hook.ps1') -Event prompt -Scope backend -HostName codex"
hooks.statusMessage: HIVMeet: routage de la requête backend
